messages:
Gina Park: ArcadiaBio (acct AB-274) opened a billing dispute for INV-2026-0601-AB. They claim a platform preempt on 2026-06-01 caused loss of burst capacity and inflated billed tokens. Asking for 300k token adjustment + 12% SLA credit on reserved fee.
Marco Rivera: Can ops confirm the event window? I'll pull pool logs for ded-2a-4.
ops-bot: Incident recorded: ded-2a-4 preempt and node rejoin 2026-06-01T08:12Z -> 2026-06-01T09:05Z (53m). Increased request retries and cache cold-start observed.
Lenore White: Customer submitted their usage CSV: committed = 3,000,000 tokens, billed = 3,450,000 tokens (overage 450k). Invoice total $19,200; reserved fee portion $12,000. They want 300k removed and 12% SLA credit -> SLA = $1,440.
Marco Rivera: Ops measurement: effective throughput drop ~40% median during window; retry-related extra tokens ~45k, not 300k. The lost burst capacity could have prevented some successful bursts but token accounting still records attempts.
billing-bot: Quick calc: overage = 450,000 tokens. At $0.005 per 1k tokens => (450k/1k)*0.005 = 450*0.005 = $2.25k. (Rate from plan: $5/1M tokens => $0.005/1k).
Gina Park: So numbers: requested token removal (~300k) equates to ~$1.50k. SLA credit 12% of $12k = $1,440. Total requested benefit ~$2,940.
Lenore White: Customer success says ArcadiaBio is strategic (pilot -> enterprise in Q3). They accept credit on next invoice, but have already paid and prefer partial refund for the overage portion.
Marco Rivera: Ops confirms event verified. Per policy: SLA credits usually applied to next invoice; refunds for settled overage allowed under $3k with manager sign-off.
Gina Park: I recommend: (A) remove 45k tokens (ops-verified retry inflation) as immediate pro-forma adjustment; (B) apply 12% SLA credit $1,440 to next invoice; (C) refund the verified overage portion tied to retries (~$225) now. That keeps exposure limited and consistent with telemetry.
Lenore White: Customer will take that. They're OK with smaller token removal if we explain telemetry basis.
treasury-bot: Refund ticket TR-REF-2026-198 created for $225. Auto-approve for < $2k.
billing-bot: Billing adjustment ADJ-2026-9102 created: -45,000 token adjustment; SLA credit memo $1,440 applied to INV-2026-0601-AB.
Gina Park: I'll message ArcadiaBio POC and close the dispute once refund posts. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
